colormaps.name: viridis

colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: magma
colormaps.description: Dark→bright with warm hues. Higher chroma than viridis.

colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: plasma
colormaps.description: Purple→yellow ramp; high chroma across the range.

colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: inferno

colormaps.name: turbo
colormaps.description: High-contrast rainbow alternative to jet. Not perceptually uniform; use when discriminating bands matters more than ordering.

colormaps.license: matplotlib (BSD-style; https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/project/license.html)

colormaps.name: thermal
colormaps.description: Heat-like; deep blue→bright yellow. Good for energy / activity magnitude.

colormaps.name: haline

colormaps.name: ice

colormaps.name: amp

colormaps.name: coolwarm
colormaps.description: Moreland's smooth diverging. Recommended default for signed anomaly fields.

colormaps.name: balance

colormaps.name: delta
